firm_data.firm_description: Attea & Attea, P.C. is a law firm serving Western New York & the Southern Tier for over 40 years. They are committed to providing legal guidance, care and representation to assist clients through almost any legal challenge.
notable_facts: Moved main offices to Hamburg in 2015.
Serving Western New York, Southern Ontario and the Southern Tier.

email.subject: AI for Attea & Attea - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Brian,

With over 40 years serving Western New York and the Southern Tier, Attea & Attea has built trust through hands-on representation. As your practice grows across Business Law and Estate Planning, precision and client trust become harder to scale without the right tools.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the region to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by Hamburg on a time that works for you to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
